method: Source-specific catalog and historical venue review; no scan pixels inspected. Coordinate sources are representative building locators, not restaurant entrances. All 30 CIA released records and all 72 selected NYPL identities were reviewed in bounded independent passes. Five NYPL machine-transcribed date candidates are corroborated by source metadata but remain visually unresolved. No source image bytes or full CIA transcripts are included.
